purpose: The clone space for cloneable machines (localAssetStorageStack#8). An engine clones a machine tagged `cloneable` once per dispatch envelope, into one block of this clone band, at the machine's initial state, and recycles the clone when its agentic action completes. Routes: RealityEngine_CI SURFACE_SPEC.md (RealityEngine_CI#713). scripts/cloneable_machines.py applies the tag and checks this file against the reserved range.

block.note: Each clone owns one block: its ISRE half holds its input and its OSRE half its output, so no two clones share a cell (the contended-cell rule).

slotRule: A machine fits a block when its input length <= isreCells, its output length <= osreCells, and n = (cells its fanout folds into, over its published-domain-bus-producer edges) + busCells <= isreCells. Document-workflow handoffs carry the assetID and fold no cells.

band.note: 1024 blocks per engine instance, above the corpus footprint. Blocks are allocated by the engine, lowest free first, so engines with identical corpora place identical clones identically.

activeClones.note: The upper bound on active clones of one template on one engine instance. It is configurable and managed at run time through /api/engine/config; the band bounds the total.
